label: Definition
name: digital operational resilience
definition: the ability of a financial entity to build, assure and review its operational integrity and reliability by ensuring, either directly or indirectly through the use of services provided by ICT third-party service providers, the full range of ICT-related capabilities needed to address the security of the network and information systems which a financial entity uses, and which support the continued provision of financial services and their quality, including throughout disruptions;

label: Definition
name: network and information system
definition: a network and information system as defined in Article 6, point 1, of Directive (EU) 2022/2555;

label: Definition
name: legacy ICT system
definition: an ICT system that has reached the end of its lifecycle (end-of-life), that is not suitable for upgrades or fixes, for technological or commercial reasons, or is no longer supported by its supplier or by an ICT third-party service provider, but that is still in use and supports the functions of the financial entity;

label: Definition
name: security of network and information systems
definition: security of network and information systems as defined in Article 6, point 2, of Directive (EU) 2022/2555;

label: Definition
name: ICT risk
definition: any reasonably identifiable circumstance in relation to the use of network and information systems which, if materialised, may compromise the security of the network and information systems, of any technology dependent tool or process, of operations and processes, or of the provision of services by producing adverse effects in the digital or physical environment;

label: Definition
name: information asset
definition: a collection of information, either tangible or intangible, that is worth protecting;

label: Definition
name: ICT asset
definition: a software or hardware asset in the network and information systems used by the financial entity;

label: Definition
name: ICT-related incident
definition: a single event or a series of linked events unplanned by the financial entity that compromises the security of the network and information systems, and have an adverse impact on the availability, authenticity, integrity or confidentiality of data, or on the services provided by the financial entity;

label: Definition
name: operational or security payment-related incident
definition: a single event or a series of linked events unplanned by the financial entities referred to in Article 2(1), points (a) to (d), whether ICT-related or not, that has an adverse impact on the availability, authenticity, integrity or confidentiality of payment-related data, or on the payment-related services provided by the financial entity;

label: Definition
name: major ICT-related incident
definition: an ICT-related incident that has a high adverse impact on the network and information systems that support critical or important functions of the financial entity;

label: Definition
name: major operational or security payment-related incident
definition: an operational or security payment-related incident that has a high adverse impact on the payment-related services provided;

label: Definition
name: cyber threat
definition: ‘cyber threat’ as defined in Article 2, point (8), of Regulation (EU) 2019/881;

label: Definition
name: significant cyber threat
definition: a cyber threat the technical characteristics of which indicate that it could have the potential to result in a major ICT-related incident or a major operational or security payment-related incident;

label: Definition
name: cyber-attack
definition: a malicious ICT-related incident caused by means of an attempt perpetrated by any threat actor to destroy, expose, alter, disable, steal or gain unauthorised access to, or make unauthorised use of, an asset;

label: Definition
name: threat intelligence
definition: information that has been aggregated, transformed, analysed, interpreted or enriched to provide the necessary context for decision-making and to enable relevant and sufficient understanding in order to mitigate the impact of an ICT-related incident or of a cyber threat, including the technical details of a cyber-attack, those responsible for the attack and their modus operandi and motivations;

label: Definition
name: vulnerability
definition: a weakness, susceptibility or flaw of an asset, system, process or control that can be exploited;

label: Definition
name: threat-led penetration testing (TLPT)
definition: a framework that mimics the tactics, techniques and procedures of real- life threat actors perceived as posing a genuine cyber threat, that delivers a controlled, bespoke, intelligence-led (red team) test of the financial entity’s critical live production systems;

label: Definition
name: ICT third-party risk
definition: an ICT risk that may arise for a financial entity in relation to its use of ICT services provided by ICT third-party service providers or by subcontractors of the latter, including through outsourcing arrangements;

label: Definition
name: ICT third-party service provider
definition: an undertaking providing ICT services;

label: Definition
name: ICT intra-group service provider
definition: an undertaking that is part of a financial group and that provides predominantly ICT services to financial entities within the same group or to financial entities belonging to the same institutional protection scheme, including to their parent undertakings, subsidiaries, branches or other entities that are under common ownership or control;

label: Definition
name: ICT services
definition: digital and data services provided through ICT systems to one or more internal or external users on an ongoing basis, including hardware as a service and hardware services which includes the provision of technical support via software or firmware updates by the hardware provider, excluding traditional analogue telephone services;

label: Definition
name: critical or important function
definition: a function, the disruption of which would materially impair the financial performance of a financial entity, or the soundness or continuity of its services and activities, or the discontinued, defective or failed performance of that function would materially impair the continuing compliance of a financial entity with the conditions and obligations of its authorisation, or with its other obligations under applicable financial services law;

label: Definition
name: critical ICT third-party service provider
definition: an ICT third-party service provider designated as critical in accordance with Article 31;

label: Definition
name: ICT third-party service provider established in a third country
definition: an ICT third-party service provider that is a legal person established in a third-country and that has entered into a contractual arrangement with a financial entity for the provision of ICT services;

label: Definition
name: subsidiary
definition: a subsidiary undertaking within the meaning of Article 2, point (10), and Article 22 of Directive 2013/34/EU;

label: Definition
name: group
definition: a group as defined in Article 2, point (11), of Directive 2013/34/EU;

label: Definition
name: parent undertaking
definition: a parent undertaking within the meaning of Article 2, point (9), and Article 22 of Directive 2013/34/EU;

label: Definition
name: ICT subcontractor established in a third country
definition: an ICT subcontractor that is a legal person established in a third-country and that has entered into a contractual arrangement either with an ICT third-party service provider, or with an ICT third-party service provider established in a third country;

label: Definition
name: ICT concentration risk
definition: an exposure to individual or multiple related critical ICT third-party service providers creating a degree of dependency on such providers so that the unavailability, failure or other type of shortfall of such provider may potentially endanger the ability of a financial entity to deliver critical or important functions, or cause it to suffer other types of adverse effects, including large losses, or endanger the financial stability of the Union as a whole;

label: Definition
name: management body
definition: a management body as defined in Article 4(1), point (36), of Directive 2014/65/EU, Article 3(1), point (7), of Directive 2013/36/EU, Article 2(1), point (s), of Directive 2009/65/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council (31), Article 2(1), point (45), of Regulation (EU) No 909/2014, Article 3(1), point (20), of Regulation (EU) 2016/1011, and in the relevant provision of the Regulation on markets in crypto-assets, or the equivalent persons who effectively run the entity or have key functions in accordance with relevant Union or national law;

label: Definition
name: credit institution
definition: a credit institution as defined in Article 4(1), point (1), of Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council (32);

label: Definition
name: institution exempted pursuant to Directive 2013/36/EU
definition: an entity as referred to in Article 2(5), points (4) to (23), of Directive 2013/36/EU;

label: Definition
name: investment firm
definition: an investment firm as defined in Article 4(1), point (1), of Directive 2014/65/EU;

label: Definition
name: small and non-interconnected investment firm
definition: an investment firm that meets the conditions laid out in Article 12(1) of Regulation (EU) 2019/2033 of the European Parliament and of the Council (33);

label: Definition
name: payment institution
definition: a payment institution as defined in Article 4, point (4), of Directive (EU) 2015/2366;

label: Definition
name: payment institution exempted pursuant to Directive (EU) 2015/2366
definition: a payment institution exempted pursuant to Article 32(1) of Directive (EU) 2015/2366;

label: Definition
name: account information service provider
definition: an account information service provider as referred to in Article 33(1) of Directive (EU) 2015/2366;

label: Definition
name: electronic money institution
definition: an electronic money institution as defined in Article 2, point (1), of Directive 2009/110/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council;

label: Definition
name: electronic money institution exempted pursuant to Directive 2009/110/EC
definition: an electronic money institution benefitting from a waiver as referred to in Article 9(1) of Directive 2009/110/EC;

label: Definition
name: central counterparty
definition: a central counterparty as defined in Article 2, point (1), of Regulation (EU) No 648/2012;

label: Definition
name: trade repository
definition: a trade repository as defined in Article 2, point (2), of Regulation (EU) No 648/2012;

label: Definition
name: central securities depository
definition: a central securities depository as defined in Article 2(1), point (1), of Regulation (EU) No 909/2014;

label: Definition
name: trading venue
definition: a trading venue as defined in Article 4(1), point (24), of Directive 2014/65/EU;

label: Definition
name: manager of alternative investment funds
definition: a manager of alternative investment funds as defined in Article 4(1), point (b), of Directive 2011/61/EU;

label: Definition
name: management company
definition: a management company as defined in Article 2(1), point (b), of Directive 2009/65/EC;

label: Definition
name: data reporting service provider
definition: a data reporting service provider within the meaning of Regulation (EU) No 600/2014, as referred to in Article 2(1), points (34) to (36) thereof;

label: Definition
name: insurance undertaking
definition: an insurance undertaking as defined in Article 13, point (1), of Directive 2009/138/EC;

label: Definition
name: reinsurance undertaking
definition: a reinsurance undertaking as defined in Article 13, point (4), of Directive 2009/138/EC;

label: Definition
name: insurance intermediary
definition: an insurance intermediary as defined in Article 2(1), point (3), of Directive (EU) 2016/97 of the European Parliament and of the Council (34);

label: Definition
name: ancillary insurance intermediary
definition: an ancillary insurance intermediary as defined in Article 2(1), point (4), of Directive (EU) 2016/97;

label: Definition
name: reinsurance intermediary
definition: a reinsurance intermediary as defined in Article 2(1), point (5), of Directive (EU) 2016/97;

label: Definition
name: institution for occupational retirement provision
definition: an institution for occupational retirement provision as defined in Article 6, point (1), of Directive (EU) 2016/2341;

label: Definition
name: small institution for occupational retirement provision
definition: an institution for occupational retirement provision which operates pension schemes which together have less than 100 members in total;

label: Definition
name: credit rating agency
definition: a credit rating agency as defined in Article 3(1), point (b), of Regulation (EC) No 1060/2009;

label: Definition
name: crypto-asset service provider
definition: a crypto-asset service provider as defined in the relevant provision of the Regulation on markets in crypto-assets;

label: Definition
name: issuer of asset-referenced tokens
definition: an issuer of asset-referenced tokens as defined in the relevant provision of the Regulation on markets in crypto-assets;

label: Definition
name: administrator of critical benchmarks
definition: an administrator of ‘critical benchmarks’ as defined in Article 3(1), point (25), of Regulation (EU) 2016/1011;

label: Definition
name: crowdfunding service provider
definition: a crowdfunding service provider as defined in Article 2(1), point (e), of Regulation (EU) 2020/1503 of the European Parliament and of the Council (35);

label: Definition
name: securitisation repository
definition: a securitisation repository as defined in Article 2, point (23), of Regulation (EU) 2017/2402 of the European Parliament and of the Council (36);

label: Definition
name: microenterprise
definition: a financial entity, other than a trading venue, a central counterparty, a trade repository or a central securities depository, which employs fewer than 10 persons and has an annual turnover and/or annual balance sheet total that does not exceed EUR 2 million;

label: Definition
name: Lead Overseer
definition: the European Supervisory Authority appointed in accordance with Article 31(1), point (b) of this Regulation;

label: Definition
name: Joint Committee
definition: the committee referred to in Article 54 of Regulations (EU) No 1093/2010, (EU) No 1094/2010 and (EU) No 1095/2010;

label: Definition
name: small enterprise
definition: a financial entity that employs 10 or more persons, but fewer than 50 persons, and has an annual turnover and/or annual balance sheet total that exceeds EUR 2 million, but does not exceed EUR 10 million;

label: Definition
name: medium-sized enterprise
definition: a financial entity that is not a small enterprise and employs fewer than 250 persons and has an annual turnover that does not exceed EUR 50 million and/or an annual balance sheet that does not exceed EUR 43 million;

label: Definition
name: public authority
definition: any government or other public administration entity, including national central banks.
